description: Stormwater Private Ponds Unincorporated is a dataset listed in Pierce County open data portal (internal.open.piercecountywa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Pierce County. This theme was created as an inventory of privately owned ponds, bioswales, and other flood prevention facilities in Unincorporated Pierce County. The data will be used to help organize the inspection of privately owned stormwater pond facilities to help prevent flooding. Coverage: Pierce County, Washington. The table has 7 columns. The portal shows 2021-08-22 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-internal-open-piercecountywa-gov-portal.
